_comment: Single source of truth for every PDF the site hosts.
'match' is a distinctive phrase from the title as it appears on the page.
tools/unbundle.py uses it to find the right card or row and attach the PDF,
so the wiring survives a re-export even if the wording around it changes.
To add one: drop the file in posters/ or papers/ under its slug + .pdf.
Nothing else. An entry with no file on disk simply shows nothing.
posters/  presentations she made herself - posters, abstracts, slide decks.
These are hers to post, so anything here can go up.
papers/   manuscripts. Only where the licence allows it: see papers/README.md.
Everything else stays a DOI link, which is what the cards already do.
'access' on a paper is documentation and drives papers/README.md.
'open' = open access, post the published PDF. 'restricted' = subscription,
accepted manuscript only. 'pending' = not accepted yet, post nothing.
